Which decision of the Supreme Court was nullified by the Muslim Women
(Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986?

Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Recent Developments in Indian Politics (Recent Issues and Challenges in Indian Politics):
In 1985, the Supreme Court ruled in the Shah Bano case that a divorced Muslim woman was entitled to maintenance from her former husband under Section 125 of the Criminal Procedure Code. questionText:
Arrange the following Prime Minister's tenure according to correct
chronological order.
(A) I.K. Gujral
(B) Narsimha Rao
(C) Chandra Shekhar
(D) V. P. Singh
 
Choose the correct sequence from the options given below:

Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Tenures in chronological order: (D) V.P. Singh (December 1989 - November 1990); (C) Chandra Shekhar (November 1990 - June 1991); (B) P.V. Narasimha Rao (June 1991 - May 1996); (A) I.K. Gujral (April 1997 - March 1998). Thus, the correct sequence is (D), (C), (B), (A).
Hence, option (D) is correct.

chronological order.
 
(A) H.D. Deve Gowda
(B) A.B. Vajpayee (BJP Minority govt)
(C) Chandra Shekhar
(D) I.K. Gujral
 
Choose the correct sequence from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Tenures: (C) Chandra Shekhar served as Prime Minister from November 1990 to June 1991; (B) Atal Bihari Vajpayee headed a minority 13-day government in May-June 1996; (A) H.D. Deve Gowda headed the United Front from June 1996 to April 1997; (D) I.K. Gujral led the United Front from April 1997 to March 1998. Sequence: (C), (B), (A) and (D).
Hence, option (C) is correct.
